hooks.command: powershell -NoProfile -Command 'Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms; $n = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon; $n.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Information; $n.Visible = $true; $n.ShowBalloonTip(4000,"Claude Code","Task finished",[System.Windows.Forms.ToolTipIcon]::Info); Start-Sleep -Seconds 4; $n.Dispose()'
